{{Quote|Come on, Chop! Get Him!|Ezra Bridger, to Chopper, as he fights the astromech droid|<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />}}
An '''astromech droid''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] onboard an [[ICM-092792|Imperial construction module]] over the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. When the [[Spectres]] arrived on the module, the [[Astromech droid|astromech]] closed several [[blast door]]s to trap the rebels and allow [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] and a group of [[stormtrooper]]s to attempt to [[Ambush on an Imperial construction module|apprehend]] them. The rebels' [[C1-series astromech droid]], [[C1-10P|Chopper]], was alerted to the situation and engaged in battle with the astromech before shutting him down.<ref name="The Honorable Ones" />
